story.storyCaption: One sunny day on Oog Island and Klik is mesmerised by something in the ocean....

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: Hey Nooby. There's something shiny in the water.
If only we could get at it.
Plus we can't go underwater in story mode.
I invented water wings so we can finally swim!
Don't you mean, TEELA invented them?
...A squishy fishy put baby squishy fishy in Nooby's tummy.
I don't like the sound of THAT.
Now Nooby touch big spikey ball and turned to stone.
It's just too dangerous to go treasure hunting.
You'd have to be an idiot go go down there again!
Is being rich really THAT important?

story.storyCaption: Klik and Nooby spend 15 seconds wondering if it's important to be rich.
At long last...All seven Apocalypse Temple symbols are revealed!

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: Hey guys, is it me, or does the clock look different somehow?
Fascinating! All seven symbols are glowing.
Oooh, Nooby not knows what pocket lips are...
...but it sounds pretty cool to Nooby!
Gross Nooby. It's not POCKET LIPS, it's...
Focus guys. We have to visit the new chamber!
I'm concerned that this new Apocalypse Temple chamber...
I didn't realize there were any other kind of Apocalypse chambers.

story.storyCaption: Beyond the disco, the Pygmies find a chamber with a mysterious closet.

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: Oooh, Oooh! Nooby hears a non-tribe pygmy's voice...
...on the other side of that big door!
Looks like some sort of closet to me.
I didn't realize apocalypse temples CAME with storage.
The sky is black, darkness looms.
So listen all, or seal your doom...
Uh, Klik. What's with the nursery rhyme?
The itsy bitsy spider went up the water spout
First you must seek a friend
A brand new friend to start the end.
His name is Tom and he's bat poo crazy.
He's on a mission to find his baby.
Klik, What are you going on about?
From only innocence can one spawn
The evil alien god Xenu from beyond.
He desires only to end our world
Before the coming of a girl.
Shhhh. Nooby. Maybe there's a clue how to stop this!
The flames that burn upon the temple
Must go out but it's not that simple.
Only with gems can you end the heat,
But each gem has only one correct seat.
Nooby wonders if this nursery rhyme is much longer.
And finally when with tasks completed,
The evil Xenu will be defeated.
Sounds like poetry slam is now over...
It'll take all day, aren't you excited?

story.storyCaption: Whew...sorry guys. Possessed Prophecy Klik was starting to bore the heck out of us.
So! The apocalypse is upon us! Make sure you check out the Challenge of the Gods to learn about all the fun apocalypse tasks you can play with.
There are many hidden surprises. details in our help and our blog:\nwww.boltcreative.com!
The end is here!
In the Locust Room, deep inside the Apocalypse Temple, another doorway has opened...

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: It seems another door has opened.
That one at the bottom of the screen.
Anyway, I'm sure whatever is through that door is all kinds of awesome.
By all means, let's go in.

story.storyCaption: In the Plague Room lies the Fountain of Death...

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: Boy, that is one UGLY fountain!
Hey Klik, suddenly I don't feel so hot.
No, I'm o.k. really. I'm totally...
Uh oh! I think this fountain is carrying a deadly plague!

story.storyCaption: In the very next room, the Purification Room, lies the Fountain of Purification.

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: Germs are bad. Gotta get rid of them.

story.storyCaption: And the moral of this story is...
...hmmm...
...Let me get back to you on that one.
The end is near!
On Apocalypse Island, the Pygmies are awaiting their doom, when...

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: Nooby found a shiny sparkly room in temple!
Oh, goodie. Another horrible death trap.
Well, let's get it over with.

story.storyCaption: By way of the Time Chamber and Locust Room, the Pygmies find the Dance Room.

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: See! New room! And it's shiny and sparkly!
Oh, what fresh hell is this?
What? I'ts groovy dooby in here!
Guys, this is too good to be true.
Somehow we're all gonna die in here!
Such is the way of the universe.
But I refuse to be a Dooby Downer!

story.storyCaption: Looks like the story got cut short. Well, be sure and try the platform to play the all-new mini-game Dance Dance Execution!
And see those balloons on the side? When Pygmies breathe their gas, they sound like a certain David who went to the Dentist, the YouTube sensation!
And check out the Dance Pack 3 in the Skin Pack Store!
It includes The Elaine Dance, Double Dream Hands, Bad Zombie and the Pygmy Theme written and performed by Parry Gripp! 99cents, cheap!
Keep an eye on story mode. The end is near!
Oh, Nooby. Give it a rest.
Back on Apocalypse Island...

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: Hey, Klak!I got something to show you! Follow me!
I'm sure you aren't leading me to a certain death.

story.storyCaption: In the Chamber of Time...

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: Big deal, it's the Time Chamber.
Check it out, the second door isn't blocked now!
Oh, great. Why not go in?
I'm sure it leads somewhere awesome.

story.storyCaption: Klak and Ooga enter a horribly disgusting goopy room with a big gross bloated locust queen.

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: Yuck! I think I'm going to throw up.
And it smells terrible in here.
...But there's a big bug in here.
That's not just a big bug..that's the locust queen!
I'm so glad that makes you happy.
If she gets enough to eat...
She'll give birth to a swarm of deadly locusts!
And they turn you into a mutant bug!
Okay, a locust isn't going to turn you into a...

story.storyCaption: To be continued. Keep an eye on story mode.
The end is near.
Klik and Ooga find themselves on yet another mysterious island with a temple that holds a weird clock-thing.

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: Here we are on yet another mysterious island.
Look! A temple with a weird clock-thing!
I wonder what it's ticking down to?
Maybe we should go inside and investigate.
By go inside, do you mean cut to the inside and we drop from ceiling?

story.storyCaption: Inside the Chamber of Time.

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: I think this is some sort of chamber of time.
How did you guess that? The caption?

story.storyCaption: In this room, Klik and Ooga find a lever that manipulates a platform.
And a time-displacement energy emanates from below.

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: Um, thanks, caption box. That was convenient information.
But, we got it from here!

story.storyCaption: Oh, okay, just trying to be helpful.

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: Anyway, depending on the platform position, different effects are felt.
Maybe it switches you with a past-self.
Or a version of yourself that moves through time differently.
Or even a version from an alternate timeline.
I once heard that the gods were considering. . .
...changing our skin color so we would be "ginger" pygmies!
How did the gods get a crazy idea like that?
I don't know, maybe some group in New Zealand complained?
Where's New Zealand? And what would they complain about?
I dunno. But I will say...
You're not getting ME on that platform! I'm outta here!

story.storyCaption: Are they gone?
Good!
To be continued. Keep an eye on story mode.
The end is near.
Once again, the Pygmies celebrate the twelve days of Fishmas!

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: and brain damage from a coconut tree!

story.storyCaption: MERRY FISHMAS EVERYBODY! And a happy Hanu-coconut!
One day, Booga and Nooby are on dry land...and not in the water, which would make a lot more sense.

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: Hey Nooby, don't get close to the water...
The last time I went diving, I found a coral reef...
I'd take you, but Dave and Allan haven't made it so Story Mode works under water.
Who's Davenallan? what's a Story Mode? I'm confused!
Forget it. Anyway, the reef is full of jellyfish!
Nooby loves jellyfish! It goes great with peanutbutterfish!

story.storyCaption: Sorry, folks, there is no peanutbutterfish in this update. Maybe next time!
It was a dark and stormy night on God Island...

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: Battling the gods! It sure takes a lot out of you.
Is that what goes on in that temple? Ohhhhh!
Right! When the pedestals have idols on them...
...One of us goes in and battles the gods!
Those are what gives us cool battle abilities!
If by 'awesome', you mean 'EXTREMELY PAINFUL' then you're right.
Sweet! Can't wait to kick some god butt!
Looks like he's off to a good start!

story.storyCaption: The Pygmies travel to the mysterious God Island where they find strange structures left by a long-dead civilization.

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: This sure is a mysterious island.
And what are these strange structures left by a long-dead civilization?
It looks like something is supposed to rest on the pedestals.
Hmmmm. According to the heiroglypics on the tomb...
There are hidden secrets in all of the locations of this realm...
It seems there are gods that are connected...
To of these trials we endure!
And when idols of these all-powerful gods are placed on the pedestals...
We will learn the dark secret of the temple!

story.storyCaption: One sunny day, a strange Pygmy arrives on the island of Oog...

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: I'm a total freakin' rock star from Mars!
ohhhh-kayyyy. But do you have a name?
I have one speed, one gear...GO!
This conversation isn't making any sense.
I've got Tiger Blood and Adonis DNA!
Whaoa. Did you just turn into a TIGER!?

story.storyCaption: Klak dreams of a strange island, the Island of Misfit Crossovers!

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: This dream land is weird, and I can't wake up!
So cool it with the shaking talk!
Last time I was here, a snake swallowed me whole!
And I found myself INSIDE the snake!
And I was chased by an angry turtle, bees, and rubber ducks!
They kept asking me to press colored buttons...
From now on, keep me outta your dreams!
But Klak-dude, this is YOUR dream.
Oh, right, then check this out...

story.storyCaption: One day, a strange new object appears on Ape Mountain..

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: Nooby feels like eyes are watching him.
Oh, its just another one of those mysterious idols.
If we're caught in its grip, it probably means certain death.
But Nooby doesn't like certain death!
Oh. Not much. I got caught in the grip of that gorilla idol.
Then I was taken by the great gorilla by the name of...
Nooby doesn't want to be taken by Konkey Dong!
Think he'd be used to that type of thing by now!

story.storyCaption: It was just an average day on the Island of Oog, when suddenly...

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: Double rainbow, oh my god. Its a double rainbow all the way.
What do you mean, what does this mean?
Its starting to look like a triple rainbow!
No it doesn't! Are you crazy?
Let's stop talking about the double rainbow...
OMG, its full on double rainbow all the way across the sky!

story.storyCaption: Klik has journeyed to Ape Mountain with Booga to stare at the view and ponder existence.

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: Oh! I try to avoid that whenever possible.
Well, its making my head hurt!
And we aren't even in the graveyard!
No No No! I meant potassium!!
Hold up! The last time I picked a banana...
...Monkeys came. and they played catch with me..

story.storyTitle: A PYGMY A DAY KEEPS THE APE AWAY
story.storyCaption: Klik and Nooby visit the peak of Ape Mountain, beyond the Pygmy Graveyard.

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: The view here is soooo pretty!
But Nooby, this is where pygmies perform an ancient sacrifice ritual!
Then, a pygmy is strung up on the Claw Altar...
Another pygmy winds him up on that winch...
Then another pygmy plays the bongo drum...
...and the Pygmy on the altar is eaten!!!
Did you hear me? Giant Ape? Scary, right?!
Yay! Can I keep the Ape as a pet?

story.storyCaption: One morning, the pygmies are getting ready for a busy day of getting themselves killed.

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: Klik! Last night I had a terrible dream
Dreams are often manifestations of deep-seated internal conflict.
Tell me, and I will analyze it!
I dreamt that the gods shook the world!
Standing on shaky ground! You see?
That was no manifestation of internal conflict!
What else was in the dream, Ooga!!
Well, in the dream, god pressed a finger against the island.
Me? Yay! I was in your dream!
And then I got an ice cream sundae.

story.storyCaption: One evening, Klik is giving a dance lesson to Klak, Boga and Nooby...an ancient and powerful tribal dance, passed down through generations.
It is accompanied by a mysterious chant, spoken rhythmically with cryptic and profound meaning!

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: My milk shake brings all the boys to the yard,

story.storyCaption: Suddenly, they feel the awesome power of the milkshake dance!

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: So much for charging for my milkshake!

story.storyCaption: Just another uneventful day on Oog Island!

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: Hey, yeah. We've never done that before!
It must be a new gift from the gods!
Or maybe it's another trick that will result in our ultimate demise!
I'm with Ooga! I fear change!
Have you noticed the plug in the underwater ruins?
The ruins we visit whenever we are swept away by Tsunami?
I guess we'll see it after the next tsunami.
Right, well anyway, when you go there.

story.storyCaption: To be continued. . .
It's a beautiful day on Dinosaur Island...

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: It sure is a beautiful day on Dinosaur Island!
Stop farting! You are grossing me out !!!
Booga won't break wind any more !

story.storyCaption: One sunny afternoon on Oog Island...

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: Maybe even get bonked on the head by a coconut!

story.storyCaption: The pygmies arrive on Dinosaur Island...

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: Where you can get eaten by a dinosaur if you disturb the baby.
Or here we can build a fire to get warm!
Only to be cooked to a crisp ourselves!

story.storyCaption: In the spooky Pygmy Graveyard...

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: Whoaaa... It's kind of spooky here.
Isn't this where pygmies get turned into zombies?
When you die here, you become a g-g-ghost!
And I sure don't want to see what made that spider web!

story.storyCaption: On the arctic ice island...

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: There's a giant ice monster somewhere!
But if you can make an ice hole, you can ice fish!
And get eaten by an ice squid!
Or hit by an ice geyser!
At least we can warm up in the igloo!
It only fits one at a time!
I guess there's only one place left to go!!!!

story.storyCaption: Back on Oog Island...
One chilly night on the Ice Island...

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: I can see that! But why?
You're way off! See how I move my hips?
Come to think of it, you had it right at the beginning.

story.storyCaption: On a remote island, deep in the prehistoric past, 6 pygmies drop out of the sky.

storyCharacter.storyCharacterDialog: Big deal. We're always dying, then we come back.
We do seem to be trapped in some kind of groundhog day.
It doesn't matter! Somewhere out there...
..is the god of this island and at any moment...
...we could be thrown in the water!
Or fed coconuts! Or maybe even fish!
Well, yeah. Coconuts and fish ARE good.
See! I'm right! I guess it's not ALL bad.
